text:
elaine (Partnerships PM): hey team :wave: quick idea — want to run an AMA-style office hours for incoming systems integrator partners next wed. focus: lab curation, onboarding playbook gaps, and cert badge flow. who can run/host?

mike (SI Enablement): I can host the first hour — content + live q&a. need slides + 2 sandboxes ready.

jordan (Solutions Eng): I can do a 20m demo on integration patterns (marketplace + private deploy). will need a pre-recorded 10m for seq batching explainer.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: please add event to shared calendar with tag #si-onboard by EOD Fri.

samir (Trainer): for certs — propose a short hands-on lab (30m) + multiple choice quiz (10 Q). want to ship a sample lab doc by Monday. Who curates HW access?

katie (Marketplace): I can coordinate hardware voucher/coupon codes with vendors. note: some marketplace partners require 48h lead time to provision.

elaine (Partnerships PM): thanks. agenda draft?

mike (SI Enablement): agenda (proposed):
1) 10m intros + goals
2) 20m marketplace + private deploy demo (jordan)
3) 30m hands-on lab (samir) — breakout rooms
4) 20m certification walkthrough + badge rules (mike)
5) 15m open AMA / ask infra

jordan (Solutions Eng): deployment checklist snippet I want to surface:```
- model pinned version
- routing policy (latency vs cost)
- KV cache warmup script
- quantization profile used
```

samir (Trainer): for the hands-on lab plan:
- objective: onboard an SI to deploy a small end-to-end app using Redwood Dedicated and Marketplace HW voucher
- prereqs: Redwood trial account, SSH key, voucher code, sample dataset (~5MB)
- deliverable: working endpoint + smoke test docs

elainE (typo fix): *elaine — ignore*

elaine (Partnerships PM): small ask: can we include a short section on support SLAs and escalation path? partners keep asking about SLOs for Dedicated vs Hosted.

mike (SI Enablement): yes — I'll add a one-pager: "Support & Escalation for SI Partners". quick bullets will do.

katie (Marketplace): vendor note — for GPU partners: please route voucher requests to marketplace@vendor-onboard, cc me. I'll compile provisioning SLA table.

jordan (Solutions Eng): logistics: how many attendees expected? I can split into 3 breakout rooms if >12.

elaine (Partnerships PM): target list = recent signups + top 8 SI leads (approx 18). plan: record session + drop assets in partner portal.

samir (Trainer): one more: certification gating — propose pass threshold 80% + successful lab deploy. badge auto-issued via partner portal webhook. needs eng-ops support to verify deploy.

mike (SI Enablement): eng-ops dependency noted. @eng-ops can we get a lightweight webhook that validates endpoint health + linked badge issuance? sample JSON payload spec below:
```json
{
  "partner": "acme-si",
  "deploy_id": "deploy-123",
  "status": "healthy",
  "test_results": {"smoke": "pass"}
}
```

elaine (Partnerships PM): perfect. next steps:
- mike: finalize agenda + slides (Fri)
- samir: lab doc + quiz (Mon)
- jordan: demo recording + checklist (Mon)
- katie: voucher provisioning notes + SLA table (Fri)
- eng-ops: webhook + badge automation feasibility (ASAP)

mike (SI Enablement): I'll queue a dry run Tue morning. can everyone be available 9:30am PT for a 30m run?

jordan (Solutions Eng): yes for me.

samir (Trainer): yes.

katie (Marketplace): yep.

elaine (Partnerships PM): thanks all — I'll create the calendar invite and post slides link here when ready. :spiral_calendar:

onboarding-bot: Event created: "SI Onboarding AMA + Lab" — Wed 10:00am PT. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/3087654321

mike (SI Enablement): noted. I'll add the dry-run invite.

elaine (Partnerships PM): closing thread — if anything else pops up, reply here. cheers! :rocket:
